subject: SOW timeline, deliverables checklist, and invoice question
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@redashsec.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contracts (Redash Security) <contracts@redashsec.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOW timeline and deliverables for Redwood quarterly pen test

Hi Marissa / Dev / Hannah,

Thanks again for choosing Redash Security for your Q2 pen test. Attached is a draft SOW and a quick invoice template so we make sure our billing matches your procurement flow. High-level:

- Proposed testing window: Apr 12 - Apr 23 (two-week active testing + 3 business days for initial report)
- Deliverables: initial executive summary, full technical report, prioritized remediation checklist, and evidence package (raw logs, PoC screenshots, and short replay videos where applicable)
- Evidence delivery: we can provide an encrypted tarball via SFTP or upload pre-signed objects to your S3 bucket.

Open items for you:
1) Confirm whether Redwood prefers SFTP or pre-signed S3 for evidence.
2) Do you require a red-team phone call window (on-call contact) during testing?
3) PO / invoice process: who issues the PO and what remit instructions should we use?

Attached: Draft_SOW_Redwood-v1.pdf (application/pdf)
Attached: Invoice_Clarification_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

If it's helpful, we can push a revised SOW with your requested evidence delivery method and an adjusted timeline.

Thanks,
Samir
--
Samir Patel
Director, Client Programs
Redash Security
samir@redashsec.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@redashsec.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOW timeline and deliverables for Redwood quarterly pen test

Samir — thanks for the draft. A few quick clarifications so procurement and security are aligned: 

- Evidence delivery: preference is pre-signed S3 links delivered to our secure intake pipeline (https://drive.redwood.com/shared/pen-test-evidence-specs). SFTP is OK as backup but PS S3 is strongly preferred.
- Scope: we'll share the in-scope app list but request tests be restricted to staging and QA environments only (unless we explicitly approve a production window).
- Finance / PO: looping in Lauren (cc) — Lauren, will Redwood issue a PO for this work? If yes, what is the expected cadence for sending the PO number to the vendor so they can invoice?

Next steps: Samir, please update the SOW to indicate pre-signed S3 for evidence and confirm the revised testing window after we share the in-scope app list. Also indicate whether you need a counterparty signature via DocuSign or if a signed PDF is sufficient.

Appreciate it —
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOW timeline and deliverables for Redwood quarterly pen test

Samir — quick technical notes from infra/eng side: 

- In-scope: web app (staging.example.redwood.ai), auth service, and metrics API. I'll attach a CSV with the canonical hostnames. Please assume any staging DB snapshots are available on request but do NOT hit production.
- Credentials: generate short-lived test creds (validity 10 days) and coordinate with our security intake at security-intake@redwood.ai for account creation.
- Evidence format: pre-signed S3 is fine — ensure objects are uploaded with server-side encryption (SSE-S3) and that filenames include the report id.
- Blackout windows: we have nightly deploys between 02:00-03:00 PST; please avoid active testing during that hour.

Attachment: in_scope_app_list.csv

Thanks,
Dev
--
Dev Patel
Engineering Manager, Platform

Subject: Invoice/PO process and DocuSign for Redwood SOW

Hi Lauren / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick replies. A couple items from contracts/finance side so the vendor invoicing lines up with Redwood's AP: 

- We require a PO number on invoices. Please confirm who will issue the PO and the expected lead time.
- Remit instructions: Redash Security will invoice net 30 to the address on the SOW unless you provide an alternate remit address.
- DocuSign: we can push a DocuSign envelope for quick counter-signature; link is below. If you prefer to sign a PDF and email it back, we can accept that as well.

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/sandbox/embedded-sign/abc123

Let us know and we will send the finalized SOW + invoice.

Regards,
Contracts Team

Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOW timeline and deliverables for Redwood quarterly pen test

Thanks — Lauren has confirmed procurement will issue a PO for this engagement. Lauren: can you confirm expected PO number issuance date? We typically turn these around within 5 business days after we sign the SOW.

Samir / Contracts team: please prepare a revised SOW that:
- Confirms pre-signed S3 for evidence (SSE-S3),
- Locks the testing window to Apr 12 - Apr 23 (adjustable if both sides agree),
- Includes a 3-business-day draft turnaround for the initial technical report,
- Adds a single bullet that Redash will not perform active tests against production systems unless Redwood provides explicit written approval and a scheduled window.

If you can send the DocuSign envelope with the revised SOW and an invoice (or invoice template with PO field), we will countersign and route the PO. Once the PO is issued we'll confirm the test creds and on-call contact for the window.

Action items (summary):
- Samir/Redash: send updated SOW and invoice/DocuSign link (by end of week).
- Lauren: issue PO after SOW countersigned (target within 5 business days).
- Dev/Hannah: coordinate test account creation with Redash after PO and SOW are complete.

Thanks all —
Marissa
